description: This file implements parallel execution utilities for the ATen library, including thread pool management, parallel region handling, and task launching functions, with conditional compilation for mobile and non-mobile environments.

classes.name: ParallelRegionGuard
classes.description: RAII guard for managing parallel region state and thread number during parallel execution.

methods.name: _set_in_parallel_region
methods.description: Sets the thread-local flag indicating whether the thread is in a parallel region.

methods.name: set_thread_num
methods.description: Sets the thread number (task ID) for the current thread.

methods.name: _unset_thread_num
methods.description: Resets the thread number to zero.

methods.name: calc_num_tasks_and_chunk_size
methods.description: Calculates the number of tasks and chunk size for parallel execution based on range and grain size.

methods.name: invoke_parallel
methods.description: Executes a function over a range in parallel, managing task distribution and exception handling.

methods.name: init_num_threads
methods.description: Initializes thread settings for OpenMP, MKL, and mobile environments.

methods.name: set_num_threads
methods.description: Sets the number of threads for intra-op parallelism, with different implementations for mobile and non-mobile.

methods.name: get_num_threads
methods.description: Returns the current number of intra-op threads, considering thread pool state.

methods.name: get_thread_num
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the current thread.

methods.name: in_parallel_region
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is in a parallel region.

methods.name: intraop_launch
methods.description: Launches a task in intra-op parallel context, using thread pool if available.

methods.name: intraop_launch_future
methods.description: Launches a task asynchronously and returns a future representing its completion.
